get.summary: Liveness. Always 200 while the process is up. Never touches the database.
Readiness. Round-trips the database so a boot-time ping actually warms the connection pool.

post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with a Google ID token obtained on-device.
Sign in as a seeded demo persona. Returns 404 unless the deployment sets DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true, and 401 without the matching x-dev-auth-secret header.
Staging only. Returns the six-digit code for a phone number instead of sending an SMS. 404 unless DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true.
Staging only. Verifies the code and opens a session, creating the account on first use. Pass asBroker to also create a broker profile.
Exchange a refresh token for a fresh access/refresh pair.
B01 — create the caller’s broker profile. Starts unverified.

patch.summary: Edit the caller’s own broker profile. 403 for someone else’s.

post.summary: B02 — puts the caller’s own profile in the verification queue (NONE/REJECTED → PENDING). A request, never a grant: PENDING is the only status it can write, and calling it again while PENDING or VERIFIED just returns the current state.

get.summary: Contacts this broker RECEIVED — the broker-side counterpart of GET /contacts, which only ever lists what the caller sent as a client. Owner-only, and without any client-identifying field (PRODUCT.md §4 rule 7).
Mirrors PropertyRepository.all()/.discoverable() — pass discoverableOnly=true for the latter.

post.summary: Publish a listing under the caller’s own broker profile (B03 save).

get.summary: Bytes behind an `api:<id>` photoAssets entry. Public, like the listing itself.

patch.summary: Edit one of the caller’s own listings. 403 for someone else’s.

delete.summary: Withdraw a listing. Soft delete to CLOSED so client contact history keeps resolving it.

post.summary: Logs a contact BEFORE the client opens the external channel (tel:/sms:/wa.me) — PRODUCT.md §3: "Journal local avant l'ouverture du canal externe."

patch.summary: Records the exchange result — 'reached' is the only outcome that opens a review.

get.summary: Mirrors DiscoveryService.findBrokers, ranked server-side via PostGIS.

info.title: Woutalma Keur API
info.description: Phase 1: broker/property read, ranked search, contact logging, review eligibility.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of the readiness query.

idToken.description: ID token returned by Google Sign-In on the device.

persona.description: Which seeded demo account to sign in as. Only available when the deployment sets DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true.

code.description: The code, returned in the response because no SMS is sent. Only ever exposed on a deployment that has explicitly enabled dev auth.

asBroker.description: Give this account a broker profile if it has none, so the broker side is reachable without an operator. Dev auth only.

refreshToken.description: The refreshToken from a previous AuthSessionDto.

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes. Decoded size must not exceed 163840 bytes — compress before sending.

title.description: Trimmed, and runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, before storage. Accents and non-Latin scripts are preserved. Must not be empty once trimmed.

description.description: Composed by the editor from the entered data, overridable by the broker. Trimmed at the ends; internal line breaks are kept.

price.description: CFA francs, integer. At least 1 — a free listing is not a product feature — and at most 10000000000.

surface.description: Square metres. Omit or send null when unknown, never 0. At most 1000000.

rooms.description: Room count. 0 is accepted and meaningful for a LAND listing; null/omitted means unstated. At most 50.

neighbourhood.description: Quartier name. The client offers a picker of known Dakar quartiers, but any non-empty name is accepted — the list is not exhaustive. Trimmed and whitespace-collapsed before storage.
